purpose: Define the dissertation Chapter 2 as scientifically complete using frozen simulation plus source-audited metadata/secondary-data confrontation, without requiring new focal field data.
canonical_question: Why need not a common broad pollinator-interaction reorganization produce one post-establishment plant response, and when can the ordering of response determinants change?

synthetic_evidence_stack.S1_conditional_geometry: one broad reorganization generates mixed, positive and negative branches across starting states and realized communities
synthetic_evidence_stack.S2_realized_richness_control: exact stepwise realized-richness matching changes the ensemble mean regime but preserves individual branching and state-by-community nonadditivity
synthetic_evidence_stack.S3_system_size: pooling independent community trajectories reduces realization variance and changes the ordering of starting-state versus community-realization contributions under active plant adjustment
synthetic_evidence_stack.S4_limit: the deterministic mean-field contrast is all-positive, so branching is finite-community asymptotically but not merely a rare-empty-community artefact over the audited finite range
synthetic_evidence_stack.S5_downstream_modifiers: local filtering reallocates branches and reproductive assurance attenuates magnitude without replacing the upstream relational mechanism

M1_formal_source_audit.role: empirical measurement ceiling and anti-overclaim boundary

M2_descriptive_world_breadth.role: biological plausibility, response-vocabulary saturation and alternative-mechanism coverage; not prevalence estimation

M3_external_compositional_examples.role: demonstrate that large partner turnover can coexist with weak/uncertain richness change; not causal validation of the synthetic mechanism

M4_izu_existing_secondary_data.role: existing-data stress test showing relational functional structure plus downstream response branching and explicit failed historical projections

chapter_claims.C1: realized richness can position a coarse response regime without determining individual branch identity
chapter_claims.C2: plant starting state and realized community composition jointly generate branch contingency
chapter_claims.C3: the relative ranking of starting-state and community-realization contributions can change across finite-community stochastic/system-size regimes
chapter_claims.C4: downstream modifiers can reallocate or attenuate responses without replacing the upstream conditional architecture
chapter_claims.C5: existing natural metadata establish plausibility and the present empirical identifiability ceiling but do not validate a universal natural threshold or historical causal chain
